summary: Backend-only testing for BidBlitz V2 audit logging integration. All 18 tests passed. Audit logging is correctly wired into all critical backend flows: auth (login success/failure, register, logout), payment (payment_failed), stripe (topup_initiated), admin (audit log viewing with filters), and profile (profile_update, password_change). Audit logs have correct structure with all required fields (event, user_id, email, ip, user_agent, details, severity, timestamp). No passwords or sensitive data found in audit logs.
passed_tests: Audit log structure has all required fields (event, user_id, email, ip, user_agent, details, severity, timestamp)
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials → audit log 'login_success' created with user_id, email, ip, role
POST /api/auth/login with invalid password → audit log 'login_failed' created with severity=warn, reason=invalid_credentials
POST /api/auth/register with new user → audit log 'register' created
Audit logs do NOT contain passwords or sensitive data
POST /api/payment/pay with insufficient balance → audit log 'payment_failed' created with reason=insufficient_balance
POST /api/stripe/checkout → audit log 'topup_initiated' created with session_id, amount, package_id
GET /api/admin/audit-logs → returns logs with total count
GET /api/admin/audit-logs with event filter → correctly filters by event type
GET /api/admin/audit-logs with severity filter → correctly filters by severity
Viewing audit logs creates admin_action audit log with action=view_audit_logs
PUT /api/user/profile → audit log 'profile_update' created with fields_changed
POST /api/user/change-password with wrong password → audit log 'password_change' created with success=false, severity=warn
Auth endpoints still work correctly (no regression)
Payment endpoints still work correctly (no regression)
Admin endpoints still work correctly (no regression)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing accounts. Test user created during register test was cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Audit logging is fully integrated and working. 46 audit logs in database after testing. Event types verified: login_success, login_failed, register, logout, payment_failed, topup_initiated, admin_action, profile_update, password_change. All logs have correct structure with event, user_id, email, ip, user_agent, details (dict), severity (info/warn), timestamp (ISO). Admin endpoint GET /api/admin/audit-logs supports filters: event, user_id, severity, limit, skip. Non-admin users get 403 when accessing audit logs.
